name: Belinsky Family Farm
description: Belinsky Family Farm is a working pumpkin patch in 132 Moose Hill Road, CT. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with picking through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
